data.desc: The Magnum Ice Cream Company is the world's largest ice cream company. With an unrivalled portfolio of brands including global power brands Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Wall's and Cornetto, and with a global fleet of nearly 3 million freezers, our products are available in 80 countries. The company generated 7.9 billion in revenue in 2024. TMICC's legal entity identifier is 25490052LLF3XH6G9847.
